acceptance_criteria: AuthenticationError has exactly one string field named Error with JSON tag error
AuthenticationFailureMessage is an immutable exported constant with value Invalid authentication credentials and is shared by Gin and gRPC middleware
middleware uses validator.NotBlank after trimming, validator.NonZero for exact-empty and selected-project checks, validator.Between for user IDs, and validator.NonNil for nil-capable values
whitespace precedence, numeric boundaries, and typed-nil behavior have regression tests
middleware constructor behavior and service authentication policy remain unchanged
command authentication tests are named authentication_middleware_test.go
targeted and broad backend validation passes
independent read-only review approves the complete diff
required_tests: typed Gin authentication error body uses AuthenticationError and AuthenticationFailureMessage
existing credential success, rejection, conflict, absence, and precedence tests remain green
whitespace-only source values preserve current fallback and precedence behavior
user ID maximum boundary and selected project ID non-zero behavior remain unchanged
typed-nil resolver, principle, nested claim information, context identity, and logger paths fail safely
renamed command tests enforce the exact authentication middleware matrix and order
risks: validator substitution could accidentally change source precedence for whitespace-only values
typed-nil handling intentionally changes panic-prone inputs into normal nil behavior
renaming tests could omit a command package from validation
rollback: Revert the implementation commit; no schema, data, protocol, or configuration rollback is required.

principles.kiss: Reuse the existing validator package and one response type without adding middleware helpers.
principles.yagni: Do not redesign authentication or add new error codes.
principles.ownership: The middleware package owns its error response and validation contract.
principles.explicit_contracts: Expose the generic authentication failure message and typed HTTP body.
principles.fail_safe: Validation remains fail closed for any presented invalid credential.
principles.observability: Existing static redacted log messages remain unchanged.
principles.least_privilege: No credential class or service permission changes.
